reply_text:
Hollis was just posting a reminder, so all I did was reply to it in the #central-team thread: "Thanks, Hollis. Noted for everyone here: expense reports are due Friday."

I didn't set up a calendar entry or a follow-up reminder, since nobody asked for one. The notes search turned up nothing on expense report deadlines, but that search ran in a reduced mode, so it doesn't prove the notes have nothing.
